epidemic-sound-rebrand.title: Epidemic Sound — Rebrand
description: As a part of a strategic shift from a music library for content creators to a soundtracking tool for professionals — a rebrand to manifest that step was necessary. The competitive landscape was a sea of sameness so an opportunity to stand out was possible.
A cross collaboration between brand, product & marketing resulted in a complete new expression for all touch points.

aira.title: Aira — Visual Design
description: Aira, a direct-to-consumer brand disrupting the residential energy market. Aira is one step closer to accelerating the electrification of residential heating, which is a major source of global carbon emissions. Aira is on Fast Company’s 2026 Most Innovative Companies list.

Integrating the brand’s presence across our digital platforms, both internal and external, is a key priority. Aira has experienced significant growth, with over 1,000 employees across four countries. We are heavily reliant on digital tools for customer interaction, heat design, planning, and installation. By providing a seamless experience across all devices and applications, we demonstrate our unwavering commitment to excellence and quality.

viaplay-rebrand.title: Viaplay — Rebrand
description: Responsible for the new visual experience of the total Viaplay product. Support our vision and product mission. Achieve a more unified product and brand experience heading in to new markets. Collaborating with product, tech and Head of Design.
Viaplay is a premium video streaming service and a leading on-demand streaming service in Europe.

epidemic-sound-homepage.title: Epidemic Sound — Homepage
description: Make the first handshake with our users as exciting and engaging as our music by injecting delight into the user experience of the main public pages. Repackage our message and offer by raising the visual level and adding emotion. Cross collaboration with design, marketing, brand & product.

viaplay-android-tv.title: Viaplay — Android TV
description: Android TV  - replacing the old cable box for Viasat customers. A collaboration between Viaplay and Viasat to develop a new app for a new platform. Linear TV meets streaming.
Creating a product strategy, design concept and implementation plan for the new Android TV experience, working closely with product owners, stakeholders cross departments and developers.

viaplay-moments.title: Viaplay — Moments
description: As a part of Hack Weeks we created a take on the Spotify Wrapped that presented your year on Viaplay. How much time you spend on viewing, on what type of content and so on. This was a collaboration between Product, Data Analysis and Customer Experience.
Viaplay is a premium video streaming service and a leading on-demand streaming service in Europe.

viaplay-trailers.title: Viaplay — Trailers
description: Introducing short trailers that autoplays without effort - to make it easier to decide on what to watch for customers.
Research, prototyping and UI design for how to bring trailers into the product the best way. Close collaboration with content team, studio and stakeholders.
Viaplay is a premium video streaming service and a leading on-demand streaming service in Europe.

viaplay-screensavers.title: Viaplay — Screensaver
description: We have seen that over 200k customers pause on their Smart TV-stream longer than 30 seconds during a day. We believed that this is a great area to show relevant title for the user. We introduced a screensaver that will launch after 30 seconds of idle time for Smart TV sessions.
We easured this by looking at completion rate, titles per user and add to my list.
Viaplay is a premium video streaming service and a leading on-demand streaming service in Europe.
